# SafeChain

> Safety intelligence software for industrial operations in Malaysia: incident reporting
> and investigation, permit to work, corrective action tracking, competency and training
> records, audits, and contractor and visitor management.

SafeChain is a multi-tenant SaaS application, not a public website. Everything except the
pages listed below sits behind authentication, so there is nothing else here to read or
index. Each customer's data is isolated per tenant and includes personal and health-related
information governed by Malaysia's Personal Data Protection Act 2010.

## Pages

- [Sign in](/login): the entry point. There is no public sign-up; accounts are created by
  invitation from a customer's own administrator.
- [Personal Data Protection Notice](/privacy): what personal data is collected, why, how
  long it is kept, and how to exercise access and correction rights under the PDPA.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): the terms the software is provided under.

## Not available

- No public pricing, trial sign-up, or self-service registration.
- No customer list, case studies, or testimonials. The product is pre-launch and has no
  completed customer deployments to describe.
- No open API. The application's own API requires a session, and the integration API (`/v1`)
  requires an API key that a customer's administrator creates for their own workspace.

## Contact

There is no public contact address published here yet. People who use SafeChain should
contact their own organisation's administrator.
